'''Raspir''' was a pure-blooded [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] released from a [[Mind prison|Rakatan mind trap]] when [[Elders|Elder]] [[Ruthic]] used the same device to banish her opponents. Raspir once served Sith [[King/Legends|King]] [[Adas]] as [[Sith sorcerer|court magician]]. As a practitioner of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], he gave Ruthic advice on how to bend the creations of a [[Star Forge (Tulpaa)|Star Forge]] to her will.<ref name="TUR" />
